name: Lenvatinib (single-agent oral multikinase inhibitor; REFLECT)

biomarkers.note: No predictive biomarker gates lenvatinib in HCC. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hepatocellular Carcinoma v2.2026, Principles of Biomarker Testing (HCC-J), molecular testing (MSI/dMMR, RET fusion, NTRK fusion) identifies subsequent-line targeted or immunotherapy options and does not select the first-line multikinase inhibitor.

lineOfTherapy: first-line systemic therapy for advanced or unresectable HCC (category 1, Other Recommended); also usable in subsequent-line if not previously used

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: preserved liver function (Child-Pugh A). The REFLECT first-line trial (lenvatinib vs sorafenib) enrolled patients with preserved liver function; therapies may have limited safety data for Child-Pugh class B or C.
eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Ch. 36; Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hepatocellular Carcinoma
eligibilityCriteria.locator: DeVita lines 111396 to 111410 (lenvatinib first-line, REFLECT, non-inferior OS to sorafenib) and lines 111720 to 111721 (preserved liver function); NCCN v2.2026 Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2) footnotes c and d

drugs.name: Lenvatinib

provenance.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2): Lenvatinib category 1 first-line Other Recommended; references 4, 5 (Kudo/Alsina, REFLECT). Per-mg dose not printed.

drugs.notes: VERIFY: lenvatinib is a continuous once-daily oral multikinase inhibitor (represented as days 1 to 28 continuous). The provided sources establish first-line lenvatinib in HCC (DeVita lines 111396 to 111410; NCCN HCC-I 1 of 2) but do NOT print the per-mg dose. The REFLECT weight-band dose (commonly 8 mg once daily for body weight <60 kg vs 12 mg once daily for >=60 kg) is NOT present in the provided source extract and must NOT be inferred; dosePerUnit, unit, and basis are set to VERIFY pending a cited source. If populated as a flat weight-band oral dose, use basis flat.

supportiveCare: Hand-foot skin reaction: monitor and manage; dose-modify per labeling (TKI class effect).

monitoring: Blood pressure at baseline and during therapy (VEGF-pathway TKI)

doseModificationRules.condition: hypertension, proteinuria, or hand-foot skin reaction
doseModificationRules.text: Hold or reduce per labeling once a concrete starting dose is VERIFY-ed; obtain clinical review. Weight-band starting dose must be confirmed against a cited source before use.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Ch. 36 Cancer of the Liver, lines 111396 to 111410 (lenvatinib first-line, targets VEGFR1-3/FGFR1-4/PDGFR/RET/c-KIT, REFLECT non-inferior OS vs sorafenib). No per-mg HCC dose printed.

guideline.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2): Lenvatinib (category 1) first-line Other Recommended (references 4, 5 Kudo/Alsina, REFLECT). The guideline lists the regimen by name and prints no per-mg dose.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for single-agent lenvatinib in advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (#22). DeVita 12th ed. Ch. 36 (lines 111396 to 111410) and Standard Guidelines (NCCN) HCC v2.2026 Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2) establish first-line lenvatinib (category 1, Other Recommended, REFLECT) but print NO per-mg dose. Because lenvatinib is weight-band dosed and the specific HCC starting dose (commonly cited as 8 mg once daily for body weight <60 kg vs 12 mg once daily for >=60 kg) is not present in the provided source extract, lenvatinib.dosePerUnit, unit, and basis are set to VERIFY and must NOT be inferred; the weight-band split must be confirmed against a cited source before populating. The continuous once-daily oral schedule is modeled as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day accounting cycle with cycles null (until progression). Eligibility captures preserved liver function (Child-Pugh A) per DeVita lines 111720 to 111721 and HCC-I caution footnotes c and d. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
